summary: Iteration 6 backend testing complete. All 13 pytest tests passed (100%). Verified: /api/books returns 2 seeded books all with non-empty pdf_url strings; /api/books/book-3d-retirement-income has pdf_url == https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/web/compressed.tracemonkey-pldi-09.pdf (exact match); book-progress endpoints (GET list, GET single, POST upsert) all return 401 without Authorization and with bogus bearer token. Regressions confirmed: /api/wp/home-feed returns hero + recommended, exclude_ids rotates hero and excludes the id from every rail (hero/tip/videos/trending/recommended/featured), /api/admin/leads gated by X-Admin-Key (rm_admin_ChangeMe_2026 accepted; missing/wrong -> 401), /api/wp/latest-modified returns ISO modified string + integer id. Per request note, book-progress happy-path with real auth was not tested (requires real Emergent session_id) — only 401 gating verified.
critical_code_review_comments: BookProgress upsert (server.py:630) correctly enforces last-write-wins via updated_at_ms and clamps page>=1; total_pages is max(incoming, existing) so client cannot regress it — good.

GET /api/user/book-progress/{book_id} returns a synthetic {page:0,total_pages:0} default when no doc exists (server.py:627); acceptable UX but note it does NOT include user_id/updated_at_ms — clients should not treat the default as a persisted record.

BookProgressIn.updated_at is Optional[float] client ms; server falls back to utcnow*1000 when missing. Order-of-arrival for concurrent posts with no client ts is deterministic per server clock — acceptable.

Seed books in BOOK_FALLBACK carry hardcoded pdf_urls; when WP `book` CPT eventually goes live, _transform_cpt does NOT propagate any pdf_url meta field — main agent should add ACF/meta-key extraction if books are ever sourced from WP.
seed_data_creation: none — book-progress happy-path not tested (requires real Emergent session_id per request note)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter6 pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_books_pdf.py covers all iter6 endpoints (pdf_url on books + 401 gating on book-progress) and iter3-5 regressions (home-feed exclude_ids rotation, admin leads, latest-modified). Full happy-path for book-progress upsert cannot be tested without a real Emergent session_id — if that becomes available, add: (1) POST with progress, GET single verifies persisted; (2) POST with older updated_at_ms proves last-write-wins rejects the write.
